description: This file implements a C++ class `WECB` which provides methods for interacting with a configuration or parameter management system, including registration, parameter retrieval, setting attributes, and object management. It also exposes several C-style wrapper functions for integration with other components, likely for automated testing or scripting.

classes.name: WECB
classes.description: A class providing various methods to manage parameters, attributes, session IDs, and object entries within a configuration system. It encapsulates the core logic for these operations and maintains integration points for external modules.

methods.name: bool initialize(IN const char * szVersion)
methods.description: Initializes the WECB component, registering necessary hooks or services.

methods.name: std::string testmodulepre_requisites()
methods.description: Sets up pre-requisites for testing the module, including registration with the system.

methods.name: bool testmodulepost_requisites()
methods.description: Cleans up or resets the pre-requisites after testing.

methods.name: void WECB_GetParamNames(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of parameter names from a specified namespace, supporting recursion.

methods.name: void WECB_GetParamValues(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves current values for a specific parameter.

methods.name: void WECB_GetParamAttributes(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves attribute information for a specified parameter.

methods.name: void WECB_SetParamValues(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific parameter and validates the operation.

methods.name: void WECB_SetParamAttribute(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets attribute flags (notify, access control) for a specific parameter.

methods.name: void WECB_SetSessionId(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets the session ID to manage component state or activity.

methods.name: void WECB_AddObject(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a table object within the system.

methods.name: void WECB_DelObject(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Deletes an entry from a table object.

methods.name: void WECB_SetCommit(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Commits changes to the system associated with a given parameter.
